change_request.title: REF: consolidate _constructor_sliced_from_mgr call sites into _ixs
change_request.author: jbrockmendel

task.task: Consolidate sliced Series construction in DataFrame._ixs while preserving indexing behavior.
subtasks: Refactor DataFrame._ixs so row and column branches select the manager and label, then share a single _constructor_sliced_from_mgr call, _name assignment via object.__setattr__, and __finalize__(self). Preserve column names by looking up self.columns[i].
Remove the _box_col_values helper and unused SingleBlockManager import from pandas/core/frame.py.
Replace the duplicated row construction logic in NDFrame.xs with self._ixs(loc, axis=0).
Run the DataFrame and Series xs tests and iloc tests, check typing and pre-commit hooks, and verify no performance regression for df["col"], df.iloc[0], and df.xs(0).

Run pandas/tests/indexes/ to verify that index formatting behavior remains unchanged.
